input: Draft a parenting agreement with my co-parent

gold.taskTitle: Draft a Parenting Agreement with Co-Parent
gold.taskDescription: Create a formal parenting agreement document together with a co-parent covering custody, schedules, and responsibilities.

questions.title: Are you starting from scratch or revising an existing agreement?
questions.description: Understand whether this is a first-time draft or an update to a prior parenting plan.

questions.title: How many children does this agreement need to cover?
questions.description: Identify the number of children involved so the plan accounts for each one.

questions.title: What custody arrangement are you aiming for?
questions.description: Clarify whether the goal is sole custody, joint physical custody, split schedules, or another arrangement.

questions.title: Does this agreement need to be legally filed with a court?
questions.description: Determine if the document must meet formal legal requirements or is an informal mutual agreement.

questions.title: Have you and your co-parent already agreed on key terms?
questions.description: Find out how aligned both parties currently are before drafting begins.

questions.title: What specific topics must the agreement address?
questions.description: Identify priority areas such as holiday schedules, education decisions, medical care, or financial support.

questions.title: Do you have a deadline for completing this agreement?
questions.description: Establish any time pressure, such as a court date, school enrollment, or a separation milestone.
